reviews.title: Life-saver airline
reviews.text: This airline is an amazing airline. They are a life-saver. We purchased our tickets in person through a travel agent at the airport. And we got our ticket through WhatsApp. (sounds really crazy, but it was real). If you want to visit Cuba and are in Cancun or anywhere else where in Cuba, this is the airline. You have to go to the actual airport and buy your ticket. But it is super worth it. The employees are awesome and very helpful. And yes, they give you 2 choices of beverages onboard: water or beer. It is a 1 hour flight from Cancun to Havana. And this is best airline out of Cancun.
reviews.author: Show_methe_sun1

reviews.title: Good Airplane not that clean
reviews.text: I have traveled with them before it is an average airplane nothing fancy, only thing I noticed since my last trip, compared with other airlines they dont give any additional attention to passengers like food, beverages or magazines. Flight was fast but the time we saved on the flight was the time we lost in the airport since the airplane remained stop for more than 30 minutes before we could leave the plane. on the back of the seats there were some used facemask and some coffe cups from other passengers so airplane wasnt cleaned well and probably not sanitized either.

reviews.title: Cheap flight and better than average overall experience
reviews.text: I got the flight along with the hotel to get a better price. The flight was alright, with snacks and drink, the plane was decent and clean, although no screens for movies. Service was good also, nothing to complain about. Only two details, a long line to reach the front desk at Cancun, and the Lady at the front desk told us to be at the gate 1:30 hours prior to boarding, this is non-sense as every flight I've been in only requires people to be 30 minutes, this also turned out to be true for this one. But anyway this is a minor detail,and overall the flight was better than I expected. Also, the logistics to deliver you to and from your hotel was nice. This is a plus if you get both things with them, and its worth it.
